project.name: Knotz Raven Mayhem
project.productGoal: Knotz Raven Mayhem is now a stage-grading arcade campaign: players keep advancing through the stage arc while stars, grade percent, coins, records, and upgrades preserve mastery pressure.
project.v1ScopeDecision: Local records and local progression only. Online leaderboards, databases, backend accounts, cloud saves, and service-worker/offline caching remain deferred beyond v1.

handoffSummary.completedThisPass: Converted the lives-gated progression model into explicit stage-grade accounting, 1-5 star ratings, grade-adjusted stage rewards, stage retry, dramatic grade reveals, S-rank confetti, run reports, grade records, a Recovery Matrix upgrade, and a Grade Shield powerup.
handoffSummary.workingBaseline: Preserve the current desktop, iPad, landscape-phone, VFX, boss, Jackpot Alley, armory, local save, release-shell, and GitHub Pages baseline. The main progression blocker from the prior handoff is now implemented locally.

Release check signal: linkedAssets=3 seedAssets=4 releaseShellAssets=10. Dist smoke signal: basePath=/Knotz-Raven-Mayhem/ linkedAssets=3 seedAssets=4 releaseShellAssets=10.
handoffSummary.devServer: A Vite dev server is already responding at http://127.0.0.1:5173/ for manual playtesting.

implementedGradeSystem.stageProgression: Missed non-bonus ravens now become escaped grade-eligible enemies instead of removing lives or ending the run. Stage flow still waits for the spawn quota plus field drain, and boss stages still require the Raven King to be defeated.

gradeMath.gradeEligibleSpawned: Incremented only for normal stage quota spawns.
gradeMath.gradeEligibleKilled: Incremented only when a grade-eligible quota enemy is killed.
gradeMath.excludedFromGradeInflation: Splitter children, boss-spit mini ravens, bosses, bonus-stage enemies, and future optional spawns do not inflate grade percentage.
gradeMath.gradeBuffer: Recovery Matrix keeps the internal thickJacket save id and adds a small grade buffer per rank without granting free perfect grades.

rewards.stageRewards: Non-bonus stage rewards are adjusted by star count. Bonus rounds keep their flat payout.
rewards.runRewards: Run payout now includes score coins, stage coins, accuracy bonus, star bonus, boss bonus, enemy/drop coins, and Bounty Chip multiplier.
rewards.balanceReport: scripts/report-balance.mjs now models learning, solid, and hot runs by grade percent and stars per stage.

records.saveCompatibility: Save version remains 1. Existing thickJacket ranks are preserved and now power Recovery Matrix.
records.newLocalRecords: bestRunStars, bestRunGradePercent, perfectStages, and bestStageStars are normalized into existing local saves.
records.recordsUi: Records now show best stars, best run grade, perfect stages, stage medals, and existing score/stage/combo/kills records.

ui.hud: Life pips are replaced by a grade cluster showing grade percent/stars, escaped count, stage aim, shield charges, and coins.
ui.stageClear: Stage clear now shows a large dramatic grade label, supporting grade percent, stars, escaped count, grade kills, stage aim, grade-adjusted reward, total coins, run stars, next-stage preview, Continue, Retry Stage, and Quit Run.
ui.stageRetry: Retry Stage restores score, coins, stars, boss credit, grade records, kills, shots, powerups, and shield charges to the checkpoint captured at the start of the current stage before replaying that same stage.
ui.sRankCelebration: S-grade clears trigger a Phaser-side confetti pop, extra spark bursts, S RANK text, and a short flash/shake when motion settings allow it.
ui.runReport: The old game-over surface is now a Run Report. Quitting from pause or stage clear banks rewards and shows total stars, average grade, perfect stages, coins, and armory recommendations.

powerups.gradeShield: The existing extraLife powerup id is now presented as Grade Shield. It stores up to three shield charges and forgives one escaped grade-eligible raven per charge.
powerups.otherPowerups: Slow-Mo, Multi-Shot, Score Boost, Overdrive, and Coin Rush behavior remains intact.

subagentWorkIntegrated.name: Grade Systems Agent
subagentWorkIntegrated.result: Confirmed lives loss was isolated to GameScene.updateEnemies() calling RunState.loseLife(), and flagged stageKills/stageTargetKills as unsafe for stars because splitter children, boss kills, and boss-spit minis inflate kills.

subagentWorkIntegrated.name: Stage Transition UI Agent
subagentWorkIntegrated.result: Mapped HUD life pips, stage-clear, game-over, records, upgrade labels, and responsive CSS areas. The implementation moved those surfaces to grade, stars, and run-report UI.

subagentWorkIntegrated.name: Upgrade And Economy Agent
subagentWorkIntegrated.result: Mapped thickJacket, startingLives, extraLife, save compatibility, rewards, and balance-report hooks. The implementation kept the internal thickJacket id, rebranded it, replaced extra-life semantics, and updated balance modeling.

manualPlaytestNeededNow: From http://127.0.0.1:5173/, start a fresh run and intentionally miss several Stage 1 ravens. Expected: no 0-lives failure, escaped count rises, grade percent/stars drop, and stage clear still appears after quota plus field drain.
Use Retry Stage from a stage-clear screen. Expected: the same stage restarts, the prior attempt does not double-count score/coins/stars, and a better replay can replace that stage result.
Clear a stage with S rank. Expected: the stage transition emphasizes the S grade first, percent reads as supporting detail, and a confetti pop celebration appears without hiding the controls.
Continue through Stage 2 and confirm stage-clear rewards explain grade-adjusted coins and the HUD still fits while grade, escapes, shields, stage aim, and coins update.
Collect a Grade Shield powerup if it drops. Expected: HUD shield count increases; the next grade-eligible escape shows GRADE SHIELD and does not increase escaped count.
Reach or simulate boss stages in normal play if possible: Stage 3, Stage 6, and Stage 9. Expected: boss defeat is still required; boss-spit minis add score/pressure without inflating grade percent.
Play Jackpot Alley. Expected: it behaves as a bonus payout round, missed enemies do not lower stage stars, and the stage clear report says Bonus Round.
From a stage-clear screen and from pause, choose Quit Run. Expected: rewards are banked, the Run Report appears, and Open Armory, Run It Back, and Menu route correctly.
Check Armory with a returning save that had thickJacket ranks. Expected: Recovery Matrix shows the preserved rank and no save reset occurs.
Check desktop, iPad, and phone landscape HUD/stage-clear/run-report layouts for overlap after the grade UI changes.
remainingProductWork: Manual balance tuning after real play: decide whether 90/80/70/60 star thresholds and reward multipliers feel right.
Boss pressure tuning after lives removal, especially Raven King duration and boss-spit readability.
Real-device phone landscape validation after grade HUD and run-report changes.
Final production art/audio pass remains optional before public release, as documented in DOCS/RELEASE-ROADMAP.md.
Final release QA checklist still must be run end to end before sharing a new GitHub Pages build.

githubPagesDeploymentNote.currentStatus: Local release verification is green after the grade conversion. The correct publish path remains manual Deploy GitHub Pages on master after manual QA is acceptable. CI verification alone does not publish.
githubPagesDeploymentNote.why: The classic Pages branch/folder source can show a blank white screen after the Vite migration because it may serve stale or mismatched static output. The Actions deployment uploads the freshly built dist artifact.

openDesignQuestionsForPlaytest: Do low-grade clears still feel exciting when the player advances instead of losing the run?
Are grade shields helpful without making 5-star clears feel automatic?
Should boss-spit mini ravens remain optional score/pressure only, or should they affect a separate boss-pressure bonus later?
Are star-adjusted stage rewards strong enough to motivate mastery without blocking progression?
Should a completed Stage 9 run show a special end-of-arc recap before overflow stages?
